t2.text: Working prototype — press Play, everything is live

s2.text: One artboard with the whole app wired to state: dashboard, projects (create, edit, delete), board with drag-and-drop between columns, backlog, list, timeline, all-tasks view, reports, task drawer (edit every field, checklist, comments, activity, duplicate, delete with undo), filters and search, sortable columns, multi-select with bulk move/delete, a Mine quick filter, and create forms with validation. Data persists in the browser between visits; the refresh button next to the user resets the demo data.

s1.text: Primary indigo #6B5CE7 (sidebar in Primary 700 #4A3DBB), secondary gold #F7D84E for key actions, cool neutral ground, Inter Tight for all type, JetBrains Mono for task keys. Primary = in progress, green = success/done, red = error/overdue. Press Play on any screen and click the sidebar to move between them.
